home_intro: Coordinate potlucks and shared events. Create an event, share a link, and let guests say what they'll bring.
home_field_email_hint: If SMTP is configured, you'll receive admin and guest links by email.
home_field_key_hint: Used to encrypt event data. Save it if you share links without the key.
home_privacy_note: No user accounts. Access via secret links only.
home_encryption_note: All event content is encrypted in the database (AES-256-GCM).
howto_organizer_1: Create an event and bookmark your admin link.
howto_organizer_2: Add must-have preset items (e.g. salad, drinks, bread).
howto_organizer_3: Share the guest link or print a QR handout.
howto_organizer_4: Moderate entries, participations, and comments. Export or delete when done.
howto_guest_1: Open the guest link and enter the encryption key if needed.
howto_guest_2: Enter your name once — it's remembered in your browser.
howto_guest_3: Add something you'll bring, or join an existing item.
howto_guest_4: Leave comments to coordinate with others.
admin_include_key_in_links: Include encryption key in copied links
admin_encryption_key_hint: Save this key if you share links without it in the URL.
admin_key_reveal_text: Your event was upgraded to encrypted storage. Save this key — it won't be shown again.
admin_done_message: This event is marked as done.
admin_done_text: The guest link no longer works. You can still export or delete the event.
admin_finish_text: Mark as done when the event is over. Guests can no longer access the list.
admin_delete_warning: This permanently deletes the event and all entries.
guest_intro: See what others will bring and add your contribution.
guest_no_items: Nothing on the list yet — be the first to add something!
share_intro: Print or share this handout with participants.
share_include_key: Include encryption key in QR code URL
unlock_intro: This event is encrypted. Enter the key you received from the organizer.
unlock_key_hint: The organizer can share the key separately from the link.
error_unavailable: This event is no longer available.
privacy_intro: This app stores minimal data. No tracking, no accounts.
privacy_storage_intro: Data stored locally in your browser:
privacy_storage_scroll: Temporary scroll position on admin page
privacy_db_intro: Event data is stored in an encrypted SQLite database:
privacy_db_encrypted: Encrypted fields use AES-256-GCM with a per-event key not stored in the database.
privacy_not_stored_key: Encryption keys (only in URLs or your memory)
privacy_not_stored_accounts: User accounts or passwords (except site admin)
privacy_retention_text: Active events are deleted after {days} days. Done events are deleted after {done_days} days.
